concern_summary: This concern addresses the verification of email domains to establish relationships between emails, specifically for private domains, while ensuring compliance with security restrictions on domain changes.

This concern encompasses functionalities that check and validate email domains, particularly focusing on distinguishing between public and private domains and their specific handling in application logic.
This concern involves validating email addresses for various input methods and ensuring they meet specific criteria for inclusion in processes such as invitations and user management.
This concern addresses the validation of domain settings and checks against predefined public domains, ensuring security and compliance in user interactions.
This concern deals with the conditional management of money requests, including checks for editing permissions, approval statuses, and the ability to place requests on hold or unhold them.

This concern focuses on the management and processing of money requests, addressing confirmation workflows, displaying transaction statuses, and ensuring that all actions adhere to relevant user permissions.
This concern is centered on the detailed display and management of money request information, ensuring that relevant details, statuses, and messages are properly rendered for the user.
This concern focuses on validating and checking the types of money requests, ensuring recognized types are processed correctly.
This concern encompasses the creation and management of money requests, including calculating amounts, managing participants, and confirming the requests.

This concern revolves around financial reporting, specifically calculating and displaying totals associated with money requests, including distinguishing between reimbursable and non-reimbursable expenses.
